properties.name: v-model
properties.description: The value bound to v-model, associated with the value of the textfield.

properties.name: items
properties.description: The data for the selectable list. When passed as an array type, each element must have an Object type with a name and a value. You can use the form {text: 'label', value: 'value'} because the item-text and item-value defaults to 'text' and 'value'.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: This message is displayed by default when no data is selected.

properties.name: itemText
properties.description: The key value that selects the value to be displayed in the list from the data object passed to items. Alternatively, you can perform a text build by passing it as a function (Added to v0.2.2).

properties.name: itemValue
properties.description: The key value that selects the value to be passed to the v-model when selecting an item from the data object passed to the items.

properties.name: itemWidth
properties.description: You can specify the width of the item list that appears when the ur-dropdown component is expanded. The unit is px.

properties.name: guideMessage
properties.description: The guide message that appears at the bottom. If there is no setting, no output. ur-dropdown does not occupy space for message output. If you want to print the message, you need to make space.

properties.name: successMessage
properties.description: The message that is output if validate passes. If there is no setting, guide message or no message is printed. ur-dropdown does not occupy space for message output. If you want to print the message, you need to make space.

properties.name: messageStyle
properties.description: You can select the style of guide message, error message or success message from 'heavy' and 'light'.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size You must enter one of two types: medium or small.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Express Dropdown as shape such as border, underline.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Rule-set for using validator. Specified by an Array type, each element returns a boolean true on successful validation and a validate failure error message.

properties.name: lazy
properties.description: Components that use ur-validator-mixin call validateOnEvent() based on component properties. If lazy is set to true, validate() will not execute when validateOnEvent() is called.

properties.name: noShake
properties.description: Determines whether shake animation should be applied to the component when it fails.
